# Browser terminal dependencies

The terminal uses xterm.js 5.5.0 and its Fit addon 0.10.0 (MIT).
These archives contain the published JavaScript/CSS/types and MIT licenses,
provisioned from an existing local installation because the npm registry was
unreachable. Development scripts/dependencies are omitted from the package
manifests. Root dependencies and lockfile reference these portable archives;
there are no links to another checkout. No runtime dependency on Claw-Empire
or VS Code is required.

Upstream: https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js
